verdict.rationale: Riveter is a hosted AI data-enrichment service, so open-sourcing it is a fair question, but the evidence shows no open-source release of the product and names no license. The only public code is a client SDK on GitHub (riveter-go), which is a client library rather than the product's source, and no license terms are given for it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
